entries.evidence: PR #407 run 36377688299 exposed the miss. Final PR #407 commit 35aa893911cc7f81df7055fcaa8c505ab2fa7f44 added check-scenario-capability-graft to packages/velvetos/policy/sensor-registry.json; later run 36379566120 included the sensor and reported NO_MISS.

PR #457 run 37034063585 exposed a relevant selector miss for check-zero-cost-final-acceptance after runtime-receipt changes. Commit 9cc4a4f855bee7712b74d79093818d346fe21930 adds packages/vfharness/state/runtime/** to this sensor's triggered_by mapping, so runtime receipt changes now select the acceptance sensor.
